modification by symbiont of host anatomical structure
related: modification by symbiont of host structure

definition: The process in which an organism effects a change that impairs the structure or function of an anatomical structure of the host organism. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: symbiont-mediated disruption of host anatomical structure
